name: Bangladesh
description: Bangladesh from the Pala empire and the Bengal Sultanate to British Bengal, partition, the war of liberation and a fast-growing nation.

checkpoints.name: Bengal of old
checkpoints.note: Bengal was part of the Maurya and Gupta empires. The Pala kings built great Buddhist monasteries, and the Sena kings followed.

checkpoints.name: Sultans and Mughals
checkpoints.note: The Bengal Sultanate made the region rich, and under the Mughals Dhaka was famous for muslin.

checkpoints.name: British Bengal
checkpoints.note: The East India Company took Bengal after Plassey in 1757. Tagore wrote, and famine struck in 1943.

checkpoints.name: East Pakistan
checkpoints.note: Partition made the east of Bengal part of Pakistan. The language movement of 1952 and the cyclone of 1970 fed anger at the west.

checkpoints.name: Bangladesh
checkpoints.note: The war of 1971 won independence. Bangladesh grew through cyclones and coups into a large garment-making economy, and students toppled the government in 2024.
